create_PascalVOCDataset: create a PascalVOCDataset instance with a data directory, split name, and optional transforms
get_groundtruth_boxes: get ground truth bounding boxes and labels for a given image index from Pascal VOC annotations
preprocess_VOC_annotation: preprocess a Pascal VOC XML annotation into tensors for boxes, labels, and difficult flags
get_image_info: get the height and width of an image by its index from the VOC annotation file
map_class_id_to_name: map a Pascal VOC class ID integer to its corresponding class name string
